name: Kryon widgets
methodology: Two frames per entry: public widget layout, interaction and paint-command generation. Deterministic monospace metrics and a recording paint host consume payloads. Pixel rasterization, system fonts and OS I/O are excluded. Sessions are retained between calls; each scenario verifies its behavior and returns zero on success. Symmetric 1.5×IQR filtering excludes outliers from the median; raw samples and excluded indices are retained. The Wasm module is unbounded, like the C and Go builds: it charges no step budget. Host gate: every measured job runs pinned (inherited affinity, no wrapper) to one logical CPU of the quietest core, chosen again before each attempt once its other hyperthread has settled, and is repeated unless that CPU kept its clock within 3% of the job median (10th to 90th percentile), the median reached 95% of the clock calibrated at start, and the hyperthread sibling was busy at most 15% of the job; Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=1 on that CPU. Rejected attempts are retained with their observations.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained
